candidate_claims.text: And friends, This Diwali of 2026 is truly special.
And I have also come to express, on behalf of 140 crore Indians, gratitude for your sacrifice, dedication, and spirit of service.
There was a time when more than 230 districts across nearly 20 states of the country were affected by Naxalism.
Just remember, in 2010, nearby in Dantewada, 76 CRPF personnel were martyred in an encounter with Naxalites.
In the same year, another incident in Dantewada claimed the lives of 44 innocent civilians.
During this period, more than one thousand security personnel sacrificed their lives in Chhattisgarh alone.
If you look at the figures from 2004 to 2013, every year more of our brave soldiers were martyred than the number of Naxalites eliminated.
The political will that was lacking in the country for this task was restored in 2014.
And after 2014, we saw both the situation and the statistics begin to change.
For years, discussions revolved around the number of security personnel being killed compared to the number of Naxalites.
But after 47 years, for the first time, not a single CRPF jawan lost his life during duty over the past year.
Therefore, until this goal was achieved, we continued to work with determination.
Friends, Just before Diwali this year, a piece of news emerged that is being discussed across the country and around the world.
What decades of slogans about removing poverty could not achieve, the country accomplished in just twelve years.
Think about how it became possible.
We created a rangoli of welfare schemes that continuously empowered the poor.
